deploymentEvidence.evidence: Official Ethereum mainnet V3 deployments list this exact Mix USDC/alUSD Alchemist separately from its MYT vault, NFT, router and transmuter. Exact proxy Etherscan page reports TransparentUpgradeableProxy and implementation address above. No V2 historical ABI substituted.
limitations: Sourcify proxy lookup was unavailable in initial research; Etherscan exact-proxy implementation report supplies the binding. No independent live storage/bytecode attestation is claimed.
Documentation lists MYT0x9B44efCa3e2a707B63Dc00CE79d646E5E5D24bA5 and NFT0x872a03FabC86b59c883CD9c439E969321b719bEB but source review does not prove current stored addresses/risk configuration.

abiEvidence.evidence: Full ABI is exact Sourcify implementation ABI applied to the explorer-bound proxy. Reviewed implementation contains real ordinary methods; exact-account-owner checks, caller-funded transfers, debt caps, fees and same-block constraints were read from deployed source. Separate proxyAbi is extracted from the exact-proxy explorer Contract ABI block; fallback/constructor create no capabilities.

selectedFunctions.label: Alchemix V3 burn
warnings: This is Ethereum V3 Mix USDC Alchemist, not the disabled V2 deployment. The exact proxy is bound to explorer-reported implementation at review; upgrades can replace it and no live bytecode/storage persistence is attested.

Deposits and repayments consume configured MYT vault shares, not raw USDC or native ETH. MYT, underlying token, position NFT, token adapter, transmuter, fee vault, rate and risk settings are storage-configured dependencies; documentation mapping is not live dependency/configuration verification.

tokenId/accountId identifies an NFT position. withdraw, mint and selfLiquidate require caller equals NFT owner; operator approvals are not enough. Existing-position deposit may fund somebody else without transferring ownership; recipient determines NFT owner only when tokenId=0.

mint creates collateralized debt. burn spends caller debt tokens; repay spends caller MYT shares and may debit target collateral for earmarked-debt fees. burn/repay can benefit a position not owned by caller. selfLiquidate clears a healthy owner position using collateral, not a promise of zero loss.

On-chain pauses, deposit caps, health/global collateralization, earmarking, synthetic issuance, transmuter locks, fees, conversion/rounding and same-block mint/repay restrictions may reject or alter effects. No caller-set deadline or minimum residual output is present; all selected functions are nonpayable and require zero native value.

Source/ABI admission does not establish balances, allowances, collateral backing, MYT liquidity, rates, configuration, executable workflows or financial safety. Existing exact grants/all mode, pauses and independent execution controls remain in force; no new privileges or API-key configuration are written.
